explore.search.placeholder.where: Explore tab, top: placeholder text in the artist search field, beside its @ icon, until you type
explore.search.placeholder.ja: アーティストをさがす

explore.search.label.where: Explore tab, top: screen readers' name for the artist search field
explore.search.label.ja: ユーザー名でアーティストをさがす

explore.search.clear.where: Explore tab, top: screen readers' name for the X button that appears in the search field once you've typed, and empties it

explore.search.searching.where: Explore tab, while searching: fine print where the results will be, while the search is loading

explore.search.artists_one.where: Explore tab, while searching: fine print over the results when one artist's handle matches

explore.search.artists_other.where: Explore tab, while searching: fine print over the results with how many artists' handles match

explore.search.notFound.title.where: Explore tab, after a search that matches no one: the heading, with the searched handle
explore.search.notFound.title.ja: {{handle}}さんはまだクロッキーにいません

explore.search.notFound.lead.where: Explore tab, after a search that matches no one: the paragraph under the heading, on checking the spelling or inviting a LINE friend with a sticker
explore.search.notFound.lead.ja: ユーザー名はつづりが正確でないと見つかりません。本人に確認してください。LINEの友だちなら、シールボードからトークでシールを贈りましょう。受け取れば、その友だちもクロッキーに参加できます。

explore.loading.where: Explore tab, on opening it: fine print under the search field while today's stickers, the leaderboards and the activity feed load

explore.you.where: Explore tab, a search result or leaderboard row that is you: under your handle, where other people's rows show their LINE name

explore.stickerBoard.yours.where: Explore tab: screen readers' name for anything of yours that opens your sticker board when tapped: your search result or leaderboard row, your sticker in Today's stickers, or your post's head in the activity feed
explore.stickerBoard.yours.ja: あなたのシールボード

explore.stickerBoard.theirs.where: Explore tab: screen readers' name for someone's search result or leaderboard row, their sticker in Today's stickers, or their post's head in the activity feed, which opens their sticker board when tapped

explore.today.title.where: Explore tab, below the search field: the heading of the first section, today's sealed stickers, beside a date badge

explore.today.none.where: Explore tab, Today's stickers section: fine print in place of the stickers when no one has sealed one today
explore.today.none.ja: 今日はまだ誰もシールを仕上げていません。

explore.thisWeek.title.where: Explore tab: the heading of the leaderboards section, below Today's stickers

explore.thisWeek.resets.where: Explore tab, leaderboards section: fine print beside the heading, when the week's leaderboards start over

explore.thisWeek.leaderboards.where: Explore tab, leaderboards section: screen readers' name for the row of three leaderboard tabs

explore.thisWeek.empty.where: Explore tab, leaderboards section: fine print in place of the rows when the chosen leaderboard has no one on it this week
explore.thisWeek.empty.ja: 今週はまだ誰もランクインしていません。

explore.leaderboards.mostGratitude.where: Explore tab, leaderboards section: the first tab, ranking people by the gratitude they earned this week

explore.leaderboards.bestCombo.where: Explore tab, leaderboards section: the second tab, ranking people by the most hits in one gratitude combo this week

explore.leaderboards.longestStreak.where: Explore tab, leaderboards section: the third tab, ranking people by their current streak of days sealing a sticker

explore.figure.hits.where: Explore tab, Best combo leaderboard: the figure at the end of each row, that person's hits in their best combo

explore.figure.streak_one.where: Explore tab, Longest streak leaderboard: the figure at the end of a row whose streak is one day, the unit set small

explore.figure.streak_other.where: Explore tab, Longest streak leaderboard: the figure at the end of each row, that person's streak in days, the unit set small

explore.feed.sealed.where: Explore tab, activity feed: a post's line when someone sealed a sticker, their handle in bold
explore.feed.sealed.ja: <artist/>さんがシールをつくりました

explore.feed.gave.where: Explore tab, activity feed: a post's line when someone gave a sticker to someone else, both handles in bold
explore.feed.gave.ja: <giver/>さんが<receiver/>さんにシールを贈りました

explore.feed.gaveYou.where: Explore tab, activity feed: a post's line when someone gave a sticker to you, their handle and "you" in bold
explore.feed.gaveYou.ja: さんがあなたにシールを贈りました

explore.feed.caption.where: Explore tab, activity feed: fine print under a post's sticker: its number, drawing time and artist's handle

explore.feed.ago.minutes.where: Explore tab, activity feed: fine print at the end of a post's head, how long ago it happened, under an hour

explore.feed.ago.hours.where: Explore tab, activity feed: fine print at the end of a post's head, how long ago it happened, from an hour to a day

explore.feed.ago.days.where: Explore tab, activity feed: fine print at the end of a post's head, how long ago it happened, a day or more

explore.failed.explore.where: Explore tab, when it fails to load: the heading of the error, over the reason and a Try again button
explore.failed.explore.ja: 「さがす」を読み込めませんでした

explore.failed.searchResults.where: Explore tab, when a search fails to load: the heading of the error, over the reason and a Try again button
explore.failed.searchResults.ja: 検索結果を読み込めませんでした

explore.failed.tryAgain.where: Explore tab, when it or a search fails to load: the small button under the error's reason that asks again

gratitude.title.where: Gratitude Mini-game, which covers the phone when you send gratitude for a received sticker: the page title in LINE's header while it's open, and screen readers' name for the game

gratitude.sticker.where: Gratitude Mini-game, top left: screen readers' name for the sticker the gratitude is for, with its number

gratitude.from.where: Gratitude Mini-game, top: fine print over the giver's handle, beside their photo

gratitude.close.where: Gratitude Mini-game, top right: screen readers' name for the X button that closes the game

gratitude.heart.where: Gratitude Mini-game: screen readers' name for the big heart's button, which you tap to play

gratitude.hint.where: Gratitude Mini-game, before the first tap: the hint under the heart, on two lines, beating like a game's start button
gratitude.hint.ja:
できるだけ速く
ハートをタップ！

gratitude.tips.stroke.where: Gratitude Mini-game, after three drags across the heart that didn't start stroking: a tip label with a swipe icon, also said to screen readers
gratitude.tips.stroke.ja: 行ったり来たり、すばやくなでて

gratitude.tips.shake.where: Gratitude Mini-game, during a hard shake of the phone, before shaking counts as hits: a tip label with a vibrate icon, also said to screen readers

gratitude.sigh.where: Gratitude Mini-game, as the combo ends: the sigh that drifts up over where the heart was, beside a wind icon

gratitude.hud.secondsUnit.where: Gratitude Mini-game, the timer bar at the top: the unit after the seconds left

gratitude.hud.secondsAdded.where: Gratitude Mini-game, the timer bar at the top: a label that rises over the bar's end as a hit lands, the seconds the hit added

gratitude.announcements.keepTapping.where: Gratitude Mini-game, screen readers only: said as the first tap starts the timer bar
gratitude.announcements.keepTapping.ja: バーがなくなる前に、タップを続けてください。

gratitude.announcements.total.where: Gratitude Mini-game, screen readers only: said on a hit at most every 1.6 seconds, the combo's gratitude so far and its multiplier

gratitude.announcements.strokeUnlocked.where: Gratitude Mini-game, screen readers only: said when fast back-and-forth strokes on the heart start counting as hits
gratitude.announcements.strokeUnlocked.ja: なでなでが解放されました。

gratitude.announcements.shakeUnlocked.where: Gratitude Mini-game, screen readers only: said when shaking the phone starts counting as hits, with reduced motion on, where the heart stays put
gratitude.announcements.shakeUnlocked.ja: シェイクが解放されました。

gratitude.announcements.heartLoose.where: Gratitude Mini-game, screen readers only: said when shaking the phone starts counting as hits and the heart comes loose to bounce off the screen's edges, with reduced motion off
gratitude.announcements.heartLoose.ja: ハートがとれて、自由に動きだしました。

gratitude.announcements.sent.where: Gratitude Mini-game, screen readers only: said as the heart reaches the giver's photo at the combo's end
gratitude.announcements.sent.ja: {{handle}}さんに{{total}}の感謝を送りました。

gratitude.receipt.label.where: Gratitude Mini-game, once the ending has played: screen readers' name for the receipt card

gratitude.receipt.gratitudeTo.where: Gratitude Mini-game, receipt card: the line under the big gratitude total, naming the giver

gratitude.receipt.best_one.where: Gratitude Mini-game, receipt card: fine print under the giver's line when the combo was one hit, its best multiplier and hits

gratitude.receipt.best_other.where: Gratitude Mini-game, receipt card: fine print under the giver's line, the combo's best multiplier and its hits, over the top tier's Japanese name

gratitude.receipt.backToBoard.where: Gratitude Mini-game, receipt card: the button with the board icon that closes the game

gratitude.failures.stopped.where: Gratitude Mini-game, when the game breaks while playing: an alert at the bottom of the screen
gratitude.failures.stopped.ja: ゲームが止まってしまいました。閉じてから、もう一度感謝を送ってください。

gratitude.failures.refused.where: Gratitude Mini-game, after the combo, if the server refuses it for good: an alert at the bottom of the screen
gratitude.failures.refused.ja: {{handle}}さんに感謝が届きませんでした。閉じてから、もう一度送ってください。
